scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,ext -c gray,white "npm run dev -w @otto/web" "npm run dev -w @otto/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @otto/web && npm run build -w @otto/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w @otto/web && npm run typecheck -w @otto/extension
